comments.text: One of the best modern indie games right now. It gives a Poppy Playtime vibe without the annoying puzzles and tiny bits of action. Finding Frankie is exciting, visually interesting, and is well done. It doesn't have long, complicated parts that you have to do over and over again, it gives you alot of action and makes sense. I love it. And that ending?? Gave me chillls. We need more games like this in 2025 and on!
